name: Crumb
description: Proof of play on Cookie Chain. CRUMB is minted only by playing Crumbs games on a fixed, supply-halving schedule. Nobody sells it and the app assigns it no price. Holders benefit when the ecosystem decides they should: partner drops, allowlists and signal votes, all counted from holder snapshots taken with Crumbs.

attributes.value: 100000 per day, halving each time minted supply crosses half of what remains
